integrity: All-size analytic derivation; a standalone exact-rational and asymptotic checker supplements but does not constitute independent validation. Literature priority is qualified by search reach.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric irreducible nonnegative stochastic kernels with uniform stationary law on complete-clique Cartesian products only; asymptotics hold with the first clique order fixed. No claim about nonreversible or nonuniform-stationary walks.
title: Cubic-root coordinate allocation in Kemeny-optimal walks on \(K_p\square K_q\)
